content.caption: Diagram of one SEAL reinforcement-learning outer-loop iteration: a language model generates candidate self-edits from a context, each self-edit is used to update the weights, the updated models are tested, and the resulting rewards drive a policy update.
content.description: A flow diagram. On the left, a light-blue "Ctx" block feeds into an "LM θ_t" box, which branches into three yellow self-edit blocks labeled SE1, SE2 and SE3. Each self-edit goes to a purple "Optimize" block applying a loss L(SE_i, θ_t), producing updated parameters θ_t′, θ_t†, and θ_t‡ respectively. A vertical divider separates this from the evaluation stage on the right, where each updated model receives a light-blue "Test" input to "LM θ_t′/θ_t†/θ_t‡" and outputs "Ans". The first two answers are marked with check marks and the third with an x. These outcomes converge into a "Policy Update" step producing θ_{t+1}. A box in the upper right labeled "RL Data" shows the tuple (Ctx with θ_t, SE, check/x), annotated State, Action, Reward.
